transcription.text: In the beginning, there was nothing, no sound, no light, no day or night, no grief, no bliss,
no grief, no bliss, just the emptiness of the abyss.
But from the darkness that emerged a single candle flame, it rose above the darkness to
lead the same out of this plane, but even now that there was a light, there was still no
one for it to fight, shining bright into the endless distance.
The flame became aware of the irrelevance of its existence.
And from this sentiment of unbearable despair, the flame transformed into a giant flame.
It could not bear to shine alone, so it torques light apart, and every burning fragment carried
embers of its heart, the sparks flew out in every direction, each one falling dream,
and where they landed worlds together, the time and water glinged.
And in those worlds woke smaller flames that did not know their name, who lit their candles
in the dark, and wondered why they came, so nothing else shines unanswered, and no light burns
alone for every flame that seeks to guide his guided by its own.
The first light lives in everyone, the lamp, the moth, the mind, the lovers finding in
the dark, what it once could not find, and when two sparks across the void meet, and the
meeting's true, the old flame feels it, and remembers, this is why I go, the fire never
says goodbye, it only changes, the candle got hurt, the wind goes dark, and something
else always remains hmmm, hmmm, hmmm, hmmm, hmmm.
